rows.en: Module 3:
rows.ne: मोड्युल 3:
rows.bt: Module 3:

rows.en: Interagency coordination and assessment
rows.ne: अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: Interagency coordination and assessment
rows.note: Proposed technical wording: interagency coordination = अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय; coordination = समन्वय. These are not additions to the frozen glossary.

rows.en: By the end of this module, participants will be able to:
rows.ne: यस मोड्युलको अन्त्यसम्ममा सहभागीहरूले निम्न कार्य गर्न सक्नेछन्:
rows.bt: By the end of this module, participants will be able to do the following:

rows.en: › Describe the role of humanitarian actors in supporting MHPSS coordination
rows.ne: › मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू MHPSS समन्वयमा सहयोग पुर्‍याउन के भूमिका निर्वाह गर्छन् भन्ने वर्णन गर्ने।
rows.bt: › Describe what roles actors involved in humanitarian work play in supporting MHPSS coordination.
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording coordination = समन्वय, absent from the supplied glossary.

rows.en: › Explain the importance of using MHPSS needs assessments in programme planning
rows.ne: › कार्यक्रमको योजना बनाउँदा MHPSS सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा प्रयोग गर्नुको महत्त्व व्याख्या गर्ने।
rows.bt: › Explain the importance of using an assessment of MHPSS-related needs when planning a programme.

rows.en: 3.1 MHPSS Coordination
rows.ne: 3.1 MHPSS समन्वय
rows.bt: 3.1 MHPSS coordination
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording coordination = समन्वय, absent from the supplied glossary. The source section code is retained; this is not activity 3.1 from the activity list.

rows.en: › The Puzzle Story
rows.ne: › टुक्रा जोड्ने कथा
rows.bt: › A story of joining pieces

rows.en: 15 min
rows.ne: 15 मिनेट
rows.bt: 15 minutes

rows.en: › How do I contribute to coordination?
rows.ne: › म समन्वयमा कसरी योगदान पुर्‍याउँछु?
rows.bt: › How do I contribute to coordination?
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording coordination = समन्वय, absent from the supplied glossary.

rows.en: 30 min
rows.ne: 30 मिनेट
rows.bt: 30 minutes

rows.en: 3.2 MHPSS Needs Assessment
rows.ne: 3.2 MHPSS सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: 3.2 Assessment of MHPSS-related needs
rows.note: The source section code is retained; this is not activity 3.2 from the activity list.

rows.en: › MHPSS Needs Assessment Scenarios
rows.ne: › MHPSS सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखाका लागि परिस्थितिका उदाहरणहरू
rows.bt: › Examples of situations for assessing MHPSS-related needs

rows.en: 25 min
rows.ne: 25 मिनेट
rows.bt: 25 minutes

rows.en: 3.1 MHPSS Coordination
rows.ne: 3.1 MHPSS समन्वय
rows.bt: 3.1 MHPSS coordination
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording coordination = समन्वय, absent from the supplied glossary. The source section code is retained; this is not activity 3.1 from the activity list.

rows.en: The Puzzle Story
rows.ne: टुक्रा जोड्ने कथा
rows.bt: A story of joining pieces

rows.en: Prepare
rows.ne: तयारी गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Prepare.

rows.en: 15 min
rows.ne: 15 मिनेट
rows.bt: 15 minutes

rows.en: • The Puzzle Story Handout, cut into pieces
rows.ne: • टुक्रामा काटिएको ‘टुक्रा जोड्ने कथा’ को वितरण सामग्री
rows.bt: • The ‘A story of joining pieces’ handout cut into pieces
rows.note: Proposed technical wording: handout = वितरण सामग्री. This is not an addition to the frozen glossary.

rows.en: Explain
rows.ne: व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Explain.

rows.en: The purpose of this exercise is to help participants understand the importance of coordinating.
rows.ne: यस अभ्यासको उद्देश्य सहभागीहरूलाई समन्वय गर्नुको महत्त्व बुझ्न सहयोग गर्नु हो।
rows.bt: The purpose of this exercise is to help participants understand the importance of coordinating.
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording coordination = समन्वय, absent from the supplied glossary.

rows.en: Before presenting any content on coordination, divide participants into small groups and give each group 4-5 pieces of the story from the Puzzle Story handout (these pieces should be cut prior to the exercise).
rows.ne: समन्वयसम्बन्धी कुनै पनि विषयवस्तु प्रस्तुत गर्नुअघि सहभागीहरूलाई साना समूहमा विभाजन गर्नुहोस् र प्रत्येक समूहलाई ‘टुक्रा जोड्ने कथा’ को वितरण सामग्रीबाट कथाका 4-5 टुक्रा दिनुहोस् (यी टुक्राहरू अभ्यासअघि नै काटेर राख्नु उचित हुन्छ)।
rows.bt: Before presenting any subject matter related to coordination, divide the participants into small groups and give each group 4-5 pieces of the story from the ‘Joining the Pieces Story’ handout (it is advisable to cut out and keep these pieces ready before the exercise).
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording coordination = समन्वय and handout = वितरण सामग्री, absent from the supplied glossary. The parenthetical strengthens 'should be cut prior to the exercise' to 'must have been cut.' The revision restores advisory strength while retaining the timing and 4-5 pieces per group.

rows.en: When distributing pieces, you can create duplication and challenges by giving copies of one piece to multiple groups, giving multiple copies of one piece to one group, or giving a different number of pieces to different groups.
rows.ne: टुक्राहरू वितरण गर्दा एउटै टुक्राका प्रतिलिपिहरू धेरै समूहलाई दिएर, एउटै टुक्राका धेरै प्रतिलिपि एउटै समूहलाई दिएर वा फरक समूहलाई फरक सङ्ख्यामा टुक्राहरू दिएर दोहोरोपन र चुनौतीहरू सिर्जना गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
rows.bt: When distributing the pieces, you can create duplication and challenges by giving copies of the same piece to several groups, giving several copies of the same piece to one group, or giving different numbers of pieces to different groups.

rows.en: Give
rows.ne: दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Give.
rows.note: The source imperative continues in the next row.

rows.en: the groups the following instruction:
rows.ne: समूहहरूलाई निम्न निर्देशन दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Give the groups the following instruction.
rows.note: The verb from the preceding source heading is repeated to make this fragment grammatical in Nepali.

rows.en: • “Put the pieces together to make a story.” When you give this instruction, address the whole group so there is no explicit instruction that they should do this work only within their own groups. Do not tell the groups that their pieces are parts of a bigger story. Allow participants to work for a few minutes. If the groups do not take the initiative to collaborate with each other, stop after a few minutes and ask them how it is going. If they say they are struggling to make sense of the story, ask them why they are not working together. This is usually enough for them to understand the purpose of the exercise. Once they collaborate and piece together the story, ask someone if they would like to share the story.
rows.ne: • “टुक्राहरू जोडेर एउटा कथा बनाउनुहोस्।” यो निर्देशन दिँदा सबै सहभागीलाई एकसाथ सम्बोधन गर्नुहोस्, ताकि उनीहरूलाई यो काम आफ्नै समूहभित्र मात्र गर्न स्पष्ट निर्देशन नदिइयोस्। समूहहरूलाई उनीहरूसँग भएका टुक्राहरू एउटा ठूलो कथाका अंश हुन् भनेर नभन्नुहोस्। सहभागीहरूलाई केही मिनेट काम गर्न दिनुहोस्। समूहहरूले एकअर्कासँग सहकार्य गर्ने पहल नगरेमा केही मिनेटपछि काम रोक्नुहोस् र काम कसरी भइरहेको छ भनेर सोध्नुहोस्। उनीहरूले कथाको अर्थ बुझ्न कठिनाइ भइरहेको छ भनेमा किन सँगै काम नगरेको भनेर सोध्नुहोस्। अभ्यासको उद्देश्य बुझ्नका लागि उनीहरूलाई सामान्यतया यति नै पर्याप्त हुन्छ। उनीहरूले सहकार्य गरेर कथाका टुक्राहरू जोडिसकेपछि कसैलाई कथा सुनाउन इच्छा छ कि भनेर सोध्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • “Join the pieces to make a story.” When giving this instruction, address all participants together, so that they are not explicitly instructed to do this work only within their own group. Do not tell the groups that the pieces they have are parts of one larger story. Let the participants work for a few minutes. If the groups do not take the initiative to cooperate with one another, stop the work after a few minutes and ask how the work is going. If they say they are having difficulty understanding the meaning of the story, ask why they have not worked together. This much is usually enough for them to understand the purpose of the exercise. After they have cooperated and joined the pieces of the story, ask whether anyone would like to tell the story.
rows.note: The instruction not to give was rendered as a requirement that participants 'must' work only within their own groups. The revision directly excludes an explicit instruction to work only within those groups, without introducing stronger obligation.

rows.en: Bring
rows.ne: फर्काउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Bring back.
rows.note: The source imperative continues in the next row.

rows.en: the group back to plenary and use the following questions as a guide for discussion:
rows.ne: समूहलाई पुनः पूर्ण सत्रमा ल्याउनुहोस् र छलफललाई दिशा दिन निम्न प्रश्नहरू प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Bring the group back into the full session and use the following questions to guide the discussion.
rows.note: The verb from the preceding source heading is repeated to make this fragment grammatical in Nepali.

rows.en: • How did you feel when you were trying to make sense of the story in your own groups?
rows.ne: • आफ्नै समूहमा कथाको अर्थ बुझ्ने प्रयास गर्दा तपाईंहरूलाई कस्तो महसुस भयो?
rows.bt: • How did you feel when trying to understand the meaning of the story in your own group?

rows.en: • What lessons can you bring from this exercise to your work?
rows.ne: • यस अभ्यासबाट सिकेका के-कस्ता कुरा तपाईंहरूले आफ्नो काममा उपयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ?
rows.bt: • What things learned from this exercise can you use in your work?

rows.en: • How would you apply this to the context you are working in?
rows.ne: • तपाईंहरूले काम गरिरहेको सन्दर्भमा यसलाई कसरी लागू गर्नुहुन्थ्यो?
rows.bt: • How would you apply this in the context in which you are working?
rows.note: The source asks hypothetically how participants 'would' apply the learning; the existing wording asks how they 'will' apply it. The revision restores the hypothetical framing.

rows.en: Ask
rows.ne: सोध्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Ask.

rows.en: What are the risks if we don’t coordinate?
rows.ne: हामीले समन्वय गरेनौँ भने के-कस्ता जोखिम हुन्छन्?
rows.bt: What risks are there if we do not coordinate?
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording coordination = समन्वय, absent from the supplied glossary.

rows.en: Summarise
rows.ne: सारांश दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Summarize.

rows.en: the risks on the slide, giving real-life examples from your experience where possible.
rows.ne: सम्भव भएसम्म आफ्नो अनुभवका वास्तविक जीवनका उदाहरणहरू दिँदै, स्लाइडमा उल्लेखित जोखिमहरूको सारांश दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Summarize the risks mentioned on the slide, giving real-life examples from your own experience wherever possible.
rows.note: The source continues the preceding heading; the verb is repeated to form a complete Nepali instruction.

rows.en: Highlight
rows.ne: जोड दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Emphasize.

rows.en: that no agency is supposed to implement all MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: कुनै पनि निकायले सबै MHPSS गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छैन।
rows.bt: No agency is expected to implement all MHPSS activities.

rows.en: This means that multiple actors from different sectors are required to collaborate and coordinate to implement a comprehensive MHPSS response.
rows.ne: यसको अर्थ व्यापक MHPSS प्रतिकार्य कार्यान्वयन गर्न विभिन्न क्षेत्रका धेरै सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू मिलेर काम गर्न र समन्वय गर्न आवश्यक हुन्छ भन्ने हो।
rows.bt: This means that many stakeholders from different sectors need to work together and coordinate to implement a comprehensive MHPSS response.

rows.en: Coordination is essential for covering gaps and responding to the needs identified.
rows.ne: कमीहरू पूरा गर्न र पहिचान गरिएका आवश्यकताहरू सम्बोधन गर्न समन्वय अत्यावश्यक हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Coordination is essential to fill gaps and address identified needs.

rows.en: Emphasize that strong coordination helps to implement the full range of MHPSS activities and promotes the complementarity of efforts across agencies and sectors.
rows.ne: सुदृढ समन्वयले MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको सम्पूर्ण दायरा कार्यान्वयन गर्न मद्दत गर्छ र विभिन्न निकाय तथा क्षेत्रका प्रयासहरूलाई एकअर्काका पूरक बनाउन सघाउँछ भन्ने कुरामा जोड दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Emphasize that strong coordination helps implement the entire range of MHPSS activities and helps make the efforts of different agencies and sectors complementary to one another.

rows.en: You can use the following quote from the MSP:
rows.ne: तपाईंले MSP बाट लिइएको निम्न उद्धरण प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ:
rows.bt: You can use the following quotation taken from the MSP:

rows.en: • “Poor MHPSS coordination (e.g. separate coordination groups for mental health and for psychosocial support, or linking MHPSS only to one sector or cluster) is associated with ineffective, inefficient, duplicative, inappropriate and potentially harmful programming. It may also result in specific MHPSS issues and/or geographical areas being left out.”7
rows.ne: • “कमजोर MHPSS समन्वय (उदाहरणका लागि, मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक सहयोगका लागि छुट्टाछुट्टै समन्वय समूहहरू हुनु वा MHPSS लाई एउटा क्षेत्र वा क्लस्टरसँग मात्र जोड्नु) अप्रभावकारी, अकुशल, दोहोरो, अनुपयुक्त र सम्भावित रूपमा हानिकारक कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनसँग सम्बन्धित हुन्छ। यसका कारण MHPSS सम्बन्धी विशिष्ट विषयहरू र/वा भौगोलिक क्षेत्रहरू पनि छुट्न सक्छन्।”7
rows.bt: • “Weak MHPSS coordination (for example, having separate coordination groups for mental health and psychosocial support or linking MHPSS to only one sector or cluster) is associated with ineffective, inefficient, duplicative, inappropriate and potentially harmful programme planning and implementation. This can also cause specific MHPSS-related topics and/or geographical areas to be missed.”7
rows.note: This is coordination guidance, not a clinical item. The psychosocial-support wording is reused verbatim from within T001's cited unreviewed candidate; the mental-health wording uses T157. No clinical validation is implied.

rows.en: • “A multi-sectoral MHPSS coordination mechanism, adequate to the context and number of agencies implementing MHPSS should be established:
rows.ne: • “सन्दर्भ र MHPSS कार्यान्वयन गर्ने निकायहरूको सङ्ख्याअनुरूप उपयुक्त बहुक्षेत्रीय MHPSS समन्वय संयन्त्र स्थापना गर्नु उचित हुन्छ:
rows.bt: • “It is appropriate to establish a multisectoral MHPSS coordination mechanism suited to the context and the number of bodies implementing MHPSS:
rows.note: The quotation continues in the following rows. The back-translation strengthens 'should be established' to 'must be established'. The revision expresses a recommendation rather than an absolute requirement. The back-translation weakens the recommendation that the mechanism should be established to a statement that establishing it is appropriate.

rows.en: » Especially in larger emergencies where there are multiple MHPSS actors, this should be a single cross-sectoral MHPSS Technical Working Group.”8
rows.ne: » विशेष गरी धेरै MHPSS सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू संलग्न भएका अझ ठूला आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा, यो एउटै अन्तरक्षेत्रीय MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (Technical Working Group) हुनु उचित हुन्छ।”8
rows.bt: » Particularly in larger emergencies involving many MHPSS stakeholders, it is appropriate for this to be a single intersectoral MHPSS Technical Working Group.”8
rows.note: Ordinary coordination guidance; the English expansion accompanies the supplied working-group label on first use. The back-translation strengthens 'should' to 'must' and loses the comparative in 'larger emergencies'. The revision restores the recommendation and comparative. The back-translation changes multiple MHPSS actors to many stakeholders, narrowing the condition, and weakens should be to is appropriate for this to be.

rows.en: » In contexts where a TWG is not needed, or where a TWG has not yet been established, MHPSS should be included in coordination mechanisms across sectors/clusters/AoRs.”
rows.ne: » TWG आवश्यक नभएको वा TWG अझै स्थापना नभएको सन्दर्भमा, विभिन्न क्षेत्र/क्लस्टर/AoRs का समन्वय संयन्त्रहरूमा MHPSS समावेश गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।”
rows.bt: » In contexts where a TWG is not necessary or a TWG has not yet been established, it is appropriate to include MHPSS in the coordination mechanisms of the various sectors/clusters/AoRs.”
rows.note: The back-translation strengthens 'should be included' to 'must be included'. The revision retains both alternative conditions while expressing a recommendation. The back-translation weakens the recommendation that MHPSS should be included to a statement that including it is appropriate.

rows.en: Online facilitation
rows.ne: अनलाइन सहजीकरण
rows.bt: Online facilitation
rows.note: Recurring facilitation terminology is absent from G-0.3; proposed wording is listed separately.

rows.en: Option 1:
rows.ne: विकल्प 1:
rows.bt: Option 1:
rows.note: A facilitation-option label, not a validated instrument option.

rows.en: The Puzzle Story Handout, distributed in pieces into a separate shareable document for each group.
rows.ne: पजल कथाको वितरण सामग्री, जसका टुक्राहरू प्रत्येक समूहका लागि छुट्टाछुट्टै साझेदारी गर्न मिल्ने कागजातमा बाँडिएका हुन्छन्।
rows.bt: Puzzle story handout, whose pieces are divided into separate shareable documents for each group.
rows.note: Recurring puzzle-story and shareable-document terminology is absent from G-0.3; proposed wording is listed separately.

rows.en: Create a shareable document for each group that includes 3-4 pieces of the puzzle story.
rows.ne: प्रत्येक समूहका लागि पजल कथाका 3-4 टुक्राहरू समावेश भएको, साझेदारी गर्न मिल्ने कागजात तयार गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Prepare a shareable document containing 3-4 pieces of the puzzle story for each group.
rows.note: Uses the proposed puzzle-story and shareable-document wording. This is an ordinary training instruction.

rows.en: Follow the same principle of in-person training; to create duplication and challenges, consider including the same piece of the story for all groups, giving one group multiple copies of one piece, or giving groups different numbers of pieces.
rows.ne: प्रत्यक्ष उपस्थितिमा सञ्चालन हुने तालिमको जस्तै सिद्धान्त अपनाउनुहोस्; दोहोरोपन र चुनौतीहरू सिर्जना गर्न, सबै समूहका लागि कथाको एउटै टुक्रा समावेश गर्ने, एउटा समूहलाई एउटै टुक्राका धेरै प्रतिहरू दिने वा समूहहरूलाई फरकफरक सङ्ख्यामा टुक्राहरू दिने उपायहरू विचार गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Adopt the same principles as for training conducted in person; to create duplication and challenges, consider ways of including the same piece of the story for all groups, giving one group multiple copies of the same piece, or giving groups different numbers of pieces.
rows.note: The source says to consider including the same piece for all groups, not merely giving all groups the same piece. The revision preserves inclusion of a shared piece within the groups' materials. The back-translation changes the singular same principle to the plural same principles.

rows.en: Review the activity instructions:
rows.ne: गतिविधिका निर्देशनहरू पुनरावलोकन गर्नुहोस्:
rows.bt: Review the activity instructions:

rows.en: • You will be given pieces of a story. Put them in order to make a story that makes sense.
rows.ne: • तपाईंहरूलाई एउटा कथाका टुक्राहरू दिइनेछन्। अर्थपूर्ण कथा बनाउन तिनलाई क्रम मिलाएर राख्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • You will be given pieces of a story. Put them in order to make a meaningful story.

rows.en: Divide participants into groups and send them to breakout rooms, giving each breakout room access to a different shareable document.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूलाई समूहमा विभाजन गरी ब्रेकआउट कक्षहरूमा पठाउनुहोस् र प्रत्येक ब्रेकआउट कक्षलाई फरक, साझेदारी गर्न मिल्ने कागजातमा पहुँच दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Divide the participants into groups and send them to breakout rooms, and give each breakout room access to a different shareable document.
rows.note: Recurring breakout-room and shareable-document terminology is absent from G-0.3; proposed wording is listed separately.

rows.en: Let them work for a few minutes and then bring them back to the main room.
rows.ne: उनीहरूलाई केही मिनेट काम गर्न दिनुहोस् र त्यसपछि मुख्य कक्षमा फर्काउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Let them work for a few minutes and then bring them back to the main room.

rows.en: Ask:
rows.ne: सोध्नुहोस्:
rows.bt: Ask:

rows.en: • Were you able to make sense of the story?
rows.ne: • के तपाईंहरूले कथाको अर्थ बुझ्न सक्नुभयो?
rows.bt: • Were you able to understand the meaning of the story?

rows.en: • What was your story about?
rows.ne: • तपाईंहरूको कथा केबारे थियो?
rows.bt: • What was your story about?

rows.en: • What would you have required to do so?
rows.ne: • त्यसो गर्न तपाईंहरूलाई के आवश्यक पर्थ्यो?
rows.bt: • What would you have needed to do that?

rows.en: During the discussion, participants may realize they had pieces of the same story.
rows.ne: छलफलका क्रममा सहभागीहरूले आफूहरूसँग एउटै कथाका टुक्राहरू थिए भन्ने थाहा पाउन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: During the discussion, participants may discover that they had pieces of the same story.

rows.en: Explain that in a face-toface environment you would have guided them to collaborate; here there was a barrier that did not facilitate coordination.
rows.ne: प्रत्यक्ष आमनेसामनेको वातावरणमा तपाईंले उनीहरूलाई मिलेर काम गर्न मार्गदर्शन गर्नुहुन्थ्यो, तर यहाँ समन्वय सहज हुन नदिने एउटा अवरोध थियो भन्ने कुरा स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Make it clear that in a face-to-face setting you would have guided them to work together, but here there was a barrier that prevented coordination from being easy.

rows.en: Ask them to share the barriers to coordination in their settings.
rows.ne: उनीहरूलाई आआफ्नो परिवेशमा समन्वयमा आउने अवरोधहरूबारे बताउन भन्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Ask them to describe the barriers to coordination in their respective settings.
rows.note: The translation narrows 'their settings' to 'their work settings'. The revision removes the added work-only restriction.

rows.en: Building from participants’ answers, use the discussion notes for in-person facilitation.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूका उत्तरहरूलाई आधार बनाउँदै, प्रत्यक्ष उपस्थितिमा गरिने सहजीकरणका लागि दिइएका छलफलका टिपोटहरू प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Building on the participants’ answers, use the discussion notes provided for in-person facilitation.
rows.note: Uses the proposed facilitation wording; G-0.3 remains unchanged.

rows.note: Retain the citation-only source unchanged: 7 MSP Activity 1.1 https://mhpssmsp.org/en/activity/activity-introduction#page-1 8 MSP Activity 1.1 https://mhpssmsp.org/en/activity/activity-introduction#page-1

rows.en: Option 2:
rows.ne: विकल्प 2:
rows.bt: Option 2:
rows.note: A facilitation-option label, not a validated instrument option.

rows.en: MHPSS Coordination handout, distributed as a shareable document for each group.
rows.ne: MHPSS समन्वयसम्बन्धी वितरण सामग्री, प्रत्येक समूहका लागि साझेदारी गर्न मिल्ने कागजातका रूपमा वितरण गरिएको।
rows.bt: Handout on MHPSS coordination, distributed as a shareable document for each group.
rows.note: Uses the proposed shareable-document wording; the source is a materials-description fragment.

rows.en: This activity should only be done in instances where an MHPSS Technical Working Group is in place.
rows.ne: MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (Technical Working Group) रहेको अवस्थामा मात्र यो गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: It is appropriate to conduct this activity only when there is an MHPSS Technical Working Group.
rows.note: The translation strengthens 'should' to 'must' and renders 'is in place' as 'has been established.' The revision preserves the recommendation and the condition that the group is present.

rows.en: The activity can be done individually or in small groups.
rows.ne: यो गतिविधि व्यक्तिगत रूपमा वा साना समूहमा गर्न सकिन्छ।
rows.bt: This activity can be done individually or in small groups.

rows.en: Create a shareable document that includes the instructions below.
rows.ne: तलका निर्देशनहरू समावेश भएको, अरूसँग साझा गर्न सकिने दस्तावेज तयार गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Prepare a document that can be shared with others and includes the instructions below.

rows.en: If the activity is done in small groups, send them to breakout rooms, giving each breakout room access to the shareable document.
rows.ne: गतिविधि साना समूहमा गरिने भए, प्रत्येक छुट्टै छलफल कक्ष (breakout room) बाट साझा दस्तावेजमा पहुँच हुने व्यवस्था गरी सहभागीहरूलाई ती कक्षमा पठाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: If the activity is to be done in small groups, arrange access to the shared document from each separate discussion room (breakout room) and send the participants to those rooms.
rows.note: The glossary lacks a term for breakout room. Proposed wording: छुट्टै छलफल कक्ष. This refers to a separate room for small-group discussion.

rows.en: Think of a time when you were a member of an MHPSS Technical Working Group (TWG) Go through the checklist of core actions of Activity 1.1: Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors.
rows.ne: तपाईं MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (Technical Working Group, TWG) को सदस्य भएको कुनै समय सम्झनुहोस्। गतिविधि 1.1: क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने अन्तर्गतका मुख्य कार्यहरू समेटिएको जाँचसूची हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Recall a time when you were a member of an MHPSS Technical Working Group (TWG). Look at the checklist containing the main tasks under Activity 1.1: Coordinating MHPSS within and across sectors.

rows.en: • Check off the core actions that the TWG was engaged in.
rows.ne: • TWG संलग्न भएका मुख्य कार्यहरूमा ठीक चिह्न लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Put a check mark beside the main tasks in which the TWG was involved.

rows.en: • Make a note of any core actions the TWG was not engaged in and consider if/how this would have enhanced your work.
rows.ne: • TWG संलग्न नभएका मुख्य कार्यहरू टिपोट गर्नुहोस् र ती कार्यमा संलग्न भएको भए तपाईंको काममा सुधार हुन्थ्यो कि हुँदैनथ्यो र कसरी हुन्थ्यो भन्ने विचार गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Note the main tasks in which the TWG was not involved and consider whether being involved in those tasks would or would not have improved your work, and how.

rows.en: Let participants work for approximately 10min minutes and then bring them back to the main room.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूलाई करिब 10 मिनेट काम गर्न दिनुहोस् र त्यसपछि उनीहरूलाई मुख्य कोठामा फर्काएर ल्याउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Let the participants work for about 10 minutes and then bring them back to the main room.
rows.note: The source duplicates the time unit in '10min minutes'; this draft interprets it as approximately 10 minutes without validating that interpretation.

rows.en: Ask:
rows.ne: सोध्नुहोस्:
rows.bt: Ask:

rows.en: • Were most core actions in place?
rows.ne: • अधिकांश मुख्य कार्यहरू कार्यान्वयनमा थिए?
rows.bt: • Were most of the main tasks being implemented?

rows.en: • Which core actions were not in place?
rows.ne: • कुन मुख्य कार्यहरू कार्यान्वयनमा थिएनन्?
rows.bt: • Which main tasks were not being implemented?

rows.en: • Was anyone part of a TWG where all actions were checked off?
rows.ne: • सबै कार्यमा ठीक चिह्न लगाइएको TWG मा तपाईंहरूमध्ये कोही सदस्य हुनुहुन्थ्यो?
rows.bt: • Were any of you members of a TWG for which all the tasks were checked?

rows.en: • Was there anything surprising in the list of core actions?
rows.ne: • मुख्य कार्यहरू समेटिएको सूचीमा कुनै आश्चर्य लाग्ने कुरा थियो?
rows.bt: • Was there anything surprising in the list containing the main tasks?

rows.en: How do I contribute to coordination?
rows.ne: समन्वयमा म कसरी योगदान दिन सक्छु?
rows.bt: How can I contribute to coordination?

rows.en: Present
rows.ne: प्रस्तुत गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Present.

rows.en: 30 min
rows.ne: 30 मिनेट
rows.bt: 30 minutes

rows.en: Activity 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors, on the screen.
rows.ne: गतिविधि 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने पर्दामा प्रस्तुत गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Present Activity 1.1 Coordinating MHPSS within and across sectors on the screen.

rows.en: Divide
rows.ne: विभाजन गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Divide.

rows.en: participants into small groups, if possible by sectors or AoRs.
rows.ne: सम्भव भए क्षेत्र वा AoRs का आधारमा सहभागीहरूलाई साना समूहमा विभाजन गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: If possible, divide participants into small groups based on sectors or AoRs.

rows.en: Ask
rows.ne: अनुरोध गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Make a request.
rows.note: Here 'Ask' introduces a request for groups to review a checklist and answer questions, rather than a standalone question. The heading changes 'Ask' to 'Say.' In context, it directs the facilitator to request an action from the groups; the revision preserves that function.

rows.en: the groups to review the Checklist of Actions in Activity 1.1 and answer the following questions:
rows.ne: समूहहरूलाई गतिविधि 1.1 मा रहेको कार्यहरूको जाँचसूची समीक्षा गर्न र निम्न प्रश्नहरूको उत्तर दिन भन्नुहोस्:
rows.bt: Ask the groups to review the checklist of tasks in Activity 1.1 and answer the following questions:

rows.en: • How could your sector/organization positively contribute to the coordination of the MHPSS response? Go through the checklist of core actions and provide some examples about the role that your sector/organization can play.
rows.ne: • तपाईंको क्षेत्र/संस्थाले MHPSS प्रतिकार्यको समन्वयमा कसरी सकारात्मक योगदान दिन सक्छ? मुख्य कार्यहरू समेटिएको जाँचसूची हेर्नुहोस् र तपाईंको क्षेत्र/संस्थाले निर्वाह गर्न सक्ने भूमिकाका केही उदाहरण दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: • How can your sector/organization contribute positively to the coordination of the MHPSS response? Look at the checklist containing the main tasks and give some examples of the roles your sector/organization can fulfill.

rows.en: • Do you have any examples from your context? Depending on the context, you may wish to add the question:
rows.ne: • तपाईंको सन्दर्भका कुनै उदाहरण छन्? सन्दर्भअनुसार तपाईंले यो प्रश्न पनि थप्न सक्नुहुन्छ:
rows.bt: • Are there any examples from your context? Depending on the context, you can also add this question:

rows.en: • What could be done in advance, as part of emergency preparedness? Give them 15 minutes to discuss and ask each group to share one example.
rows.ne: • आपत्कालीन पूर्वतयारीको अङ्गका रूपमा अग्रिम रूपमा के गर्न सकिन्छ? उनीहरूलाई छलफल गर्न 15 मिनेट दिनुहोस् र प्रत्येक समूहलाई एउटा उदाहरण साझा गर्न भन्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • What can be done in advance as part of emergency preparedness? Give them 15 minutes to discuss and ask each group to share one example.

rows.en: Summarize
rows.ne: सारांश प्रस्तुत गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Present a summary.
rows.note: The supplied provenance places this heading outside the visible page boundary; source inclusion remains unverified.

rows.en: the importance of coordination and underscore the following:
rows.ne: समन्वयको महत्त्वको सारांश प्रस्तुत गर्नुहोस् र निम्न कुराहरूमा जोड दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Present a summary of the importance of coordination and emphasize the following points.
rows.note: The source continues the preceding 'Summarize' heading; the draft makes that grammatical relationship explicit, while source inclusion outside the visible page boundary remains unverified.

rows.en: • Coordination is critical and it’s everyone’s responsibility.
rows.ne: • समन्वय अत्यन्त महत्त्वपूर्ण छ र यो सबैको जिम्मेवारी हो।
rows.bt: • Coordination is extremely important and it is everyone's responsibility.
rows.note: The supplied provenance places this row outside the visible page boundary; source inclusion remains unverified.

rows.en: • We just reviewed Activity 1.1, Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors, which provides guidance on interagency coordination mechanisms.
rows.ne: • हामीले भर्खरै गतिविधि 1.1, “क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने”, को समीक्षा गर्‍यौँ, जसले अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय संयन्त्रहरूबारे मार्गदर्शन दिन्छ।
rows.bt: • We have just reviewed activity 1.1, “Coordinating MHPSS within and between sectors”, which provides guidance on inter-agency coordination mechanisms.
rows.note: The supplied provenance places this row outside the visible page boundary; source inclusion remains unverified.

rows.en: • But we also need to look internally at our own organizations to see if we are designing our own programming in a way that is well-coordinated.
rows.ne: • तर हामीले आफ्नै कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनको रूपरेखा राम्ररी समन्वय हुने गरी तयार गरिरहेका छौँ कि छैनौँ भनेर आफ्ना संस्थाहरूभित्र पनि हेर्नु आवश्यक छ।
rows.bt: • But we also need to look within our own organizations to see whether or not we are preparing the framework for our own programme formulation and implementation in a way that ensures good coordination.
rows.note: The supplied provenance places this row outside the visible page boundary; source inclusion remains unverified.

rows.en: • MSP Activity 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate MHPSS Programs includes actions to help us do this. E.g.
rows.ne: • MSP गतिविधि 2.1, “MHPSS कार्यक्रमहरूको रूपरेखा तयार गर्ने, योजना बनाउने र समन्वय गर्ने”, मा हामीलाई यसो गर्न मद्दत गर्ने कार्यहरू समावेश छन्। उदाहरणका लागि।
rows.bt: • MSP activity 2.1, “Preparing the framework for, planning and coordinating MHPSS programmes”, includes actions that help us do this. For example.
rows.note: Source inclusion outside the visible page boundary remains unverified, and the previously cited activity-label candidate T094 is absent from the supplied glossary; the label is drafted from the supplied English.

rows.en: » Making sure our organization is represented in coordination mechanisms
rows.ne: » समन्वय संयन्त्रहरूमा हाम्रो संस्थाको प्रतिनिधित्व सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: » Ensuring our organization's representation in coordination mechanisms.
rows.note: The supplied provenance places this row outside the visible page boundary; source inclusion remains unverified.

rows.en: » Making sure we are complementing the work of other organizations, avoiding duplication, and referring appropriately
rows.ne: » हामीले अरू संस्थाहरूको काममा पूरक योगदान दिइरहेका छौँ, दोहोरोपनबाट जोगिइरहेका छौँ र उपयुक्त रूपमा प्रेषण गरिरहेका छौँ भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Ensure that we are making a complementary contribution to the work of other organizations, avoiding duplication, and making referrals appropriately.
rows.note: Source inclusion outside the visible page boundary remains unverified; no supplied glossary candidate covers referral, which is drafted without specifying a recipient or destination absent from the source. Although the BT matches the English, the Nepali says we are making other organizations' work complementary, rather than complementing their work. The repair corrects that relationship.

rows.en: » Sharing information about our current or planned MHPSS activities
rows.ne: » हाम्रा हालका वा योजनामा रहेका MHPSS गतिविधिहरूबारे जानकारी साझा गर्ने।
rows.bt: » Sharing information about our current or planned MHPSS activities.
rows.note: The supplied provenance places this row outside the visible page boundary; source inclusion remains unverified.

rows.en: » Getting feedback & promoting best practices & standards
rows.ne: » पृष्ठपोषण प्राप्त गर्ने र उत्तम अभ्यासहरू तथा मापदण्डहरूलाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने।
rows.bt: » Receiving feedback and promoting best practices and standards.
rows.note: Source inclusion outside the visible page boundary remains unverified; the supplied glossary contains the candidates for best practices and standards, so the previous glossary-missing flag is not retained.

rows.en: » Attending interagency trainings
rows.ne: » अन्तर-निकाय तालिमहरूमा सहभागी हुने।
rows.bt: » Participating in inter-agency trainings.
rows.note: Source inclusion outside the visible page boundary remains unverified; the supplied glossary contains the interagency trainings candidate, so the previous glossary-missing flag is not retained.

rows.en: » This can also guide us in how to coordinate within our sector if there is no inter-sectoral MHPSS TWG in place. That’s why it is highly recommended to look at the core actions under this activity to ensure that your organization is positively contributing to coordination.
rows.ne: » यदि क्षेत्रहरूबीचको MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (MHPSS TWG) छैन भने, यसले हाम्रो क्षेत्रभित्र कसरी समन्वय गर्ने भन्ने विषयमा पनि हामीलाई मार्गदर्शन गर्न सक्छ। त्यसैले, तपाईंको संस्थाले समन्वयमा सकारात्मक योगदान दिइरहेको छ भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्न यस गतिविधिअन्तर्गतका मुख्य कार्यहरू हेर्न जोडदार सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: » If there is no intersectoral MHPSS technical working group (MHPSS TWG), it can also guide us on how to coordinate within our sector. Therefore, it is strongly recommended to look at the main actions under this activity to ensure that your organization is making a positive contribution to coordination.
rows.note: Source review remains pending because the supplied provenance note places this text outside the visible page boundary; the condition, possibility and strong recommendation are retained.

rows.en: Explain that there is a dedicated IASC handbook on MHPSS coordination, which was also released in 2022 – it’s consistent with the checklist for MSP Activity 1.1 (Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors), but goes in to much more detail on how to coordinate.
rows.ne: MHPSS समन्वयका लागि छुट्टै IASC पुस्तिका रहेको, त्यो पनि 2022 मा प्रकाशित भएको र त्यो MSP गतिविधि 1.1 (क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने) को जाँचसूचीसँग सुसंगत भए पनि समन्वय कसरी गर्ने भन्नेबारे धेरै विस्तृत जानकारी दिने कुरा स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Clarify that there is a separate IASC handbook for MHPSS coordination, that it too was published in 2022, and that although it is consistent with the checklist for MSP activity 1.1 (coordinating MHPSS within and between sectors), it provides much more detailed information on how to coordinate.
rows.note: Source review remains pending because the supplied provenance note places this text outside the visible page boundary; 2022, activity code 1.1, checklist consistency and the greater level of coordination detail are retained.

rows.en: The handbook provides guidance on how to best support well-coordinated and multisectoral MHPSS responses that are predictable, accountable, equitable, efficient and effective.
rows.ne: राम्रोसँग समन्वय गरिएका, बहु-क्षेत्रगत, पूर्वानुमान गर्न सकिने, जवाफदेही, समतामूलक, दक्ष र प्रभावकारी MHPSS प्रतिकार्यहरूलाई सर्वोत्तम रूपमा कसरी सहयोग गर्ने भन्नेबारे पुस्तिकाले मार्गदर्शन दिन्छ।
rows.bt: The handbook provides guidance on how best to support well-coordinated, multisectoral, predictable, accountable, equitable, efficient and effective MHPSS responses.
rows.note: Source review remains pending because the supplied provenance note places this text outside the visible page boundary; all stated qualities of the MHPSS responses are retained.

rows.en: Summarize
rows.ne: सारांश प्रस्तुत गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Present a summary.

rows.en: the importance of coordination and underscore the following:
rows.ne: समन्वयको महत्त्वको सारांश प्रस्तुत गर्नुहोस् र निम्न पक्षहरूमा जोड दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Summarize the importance of coordination and emphasize the following aspects.
rows.note: The source continues the preceding heading; rendered as a complete instruction.

rows.en: • Coordination is critical and it’s everyone’s responsibility.
rows.ne: • समन्वय अत्यन्त महत्त्वपूर्ण छ र यो सबैको जिम्मेवारी हो।
rows.bt: Coordination is extremely important and is everyone's responsibility.

rows.en: • We just reviewed Activity 1.1, Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors, which provides guidance on interagency coordination mechanisms.
rows.ne: • हामीले भर्खरै गतिविधि 1.1, क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने, को समीक्षा गर्‍यौँ। यसले अन्तर-निकाय समन्वय संयन्त्रहरूबारे मार्गदर्शन प्रदान गर्छ।
rows.bt: We have just reviewed activity 1.1, Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors. It provides guidance on inter-agency coordination mechanisms.

rows.en: • But we also need to look internally at our own organizations to see if we are designing our own programming in a way that is well-coordinated.
rows.ne: • तर हामीले आफ्नै संस्थाभित्र पनि हेर्नुपर्छ, ताकि हामीले आफ्नै कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयन सुव्यवस्थित रूपमा समन्वय हुने गरी तयार गरिरहेका छौँ कि छैनौँ भन्ने थाहा पाउन सकियोस्।
rows.bt: But we must also look within our own organization so that we can find out whether we are preparing our own programme formulation and implementation in a way that ensures they are well coordinated.

rows.en: • MSP Activity 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate MHPSS Programs includes actions to help us do this. E.g.
rows.ne: • MSP गतिविधि 2.1, MHPSS कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, योजना र समन्वय गर्ने, मा हामीलाई यसो गर्न सघाउने कार्यहरू समावेश छन्। उदाहरणका लागि:
rows.bt: MSP activity 2.1, Design, plan and coordinate the MHPSS programme, includes actions that help us do this. For example:

rows.en: » Making sure our organization is represented in coordination mechanisms
rows.ne: » समन्वय संयन्त्रहरूमा हाम्रो संस्थाको प्रतिनिधित्व भएको सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Ensure that our organization is represented in coordination mechanisms.

rows.en: » Making sure we are complementing the work of other organizations, avoiding duplication, and referring appropriately
rows.ne: » हामीले अन्य संस्थाहरूको कामलाई पूरक सहयोग गरिरहेका छौँ, कामको दोहोरोपनबाट जोगिइरहेका छौँ र उपयुक्त रूपमा सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाइरहेका छौँ भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Ensure that we are providing support that complements the work of other organizations, avoiding duplication of work and referring to relevant services as appropriate.
rows.note: General guidance on complementary work, avoiding duplication and appropriate referral; safety review pending.

rows.en: » Sharing information about our current or planned MHPSS activities
rows.ne: » हाम्रा हाल सञ्चालनमा रहेका वा योजनाबद्ध MHPSS गतिविधिहरूबारे जानकारी साझा गर्ने।
rows.bt: Share information about our currently ongoing or planned MHPSS activities.

rows.en: » Getting feedback & promoting best practices & standards
rows.ne: » पृष्ठपोषण प्राप्त गर्ने तथा उत्तम अभ्यासहरू र मापदण्डहरू प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने।
rows.bt: Receive feedback and promote best practices and standards.
rows.note: Proposed recurring term: best practices = उत्तम अभ्यासहरू.

rows.en: » Attending interagency trainings
rows.ne: » अन्तर-निकाय तालिमहरूमा सहभागी हुने।
rows.bt: Participate in inter-agency training sessions.
rows.note: Proposed recurring term: interagency trainings = अन्तर-निकाय तालिमहरू.

rows.en: » This can also guide us in how to coordinate within our sector if there is no inter-sectoral MHPSS TWG in place. That’s why it is highly recommended to look at the core actions under this activity to ensure that your organization is positively contributing to coordination.
rows.ne: » अन्तर-क्षेत्रगत MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (MHPSS TWG) स्थापना भएको छैन भने यसले हामीलाई हाम्रो क्षेत्रभित्र कसरी समन्वय गर्ने भन्ने विषयमा पनि मार्गदर्शन गर्न सक्छ। त्यसैले तपाईंको संस्थाले समन्वयमा सकारात्मक योगदान दिइरहेको सुनिश्चित गर्न यस गतिविधिअन्तर्गतका मुख्य कार्यहरू हेर्न जोडदार सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: If an inter-sectoral MHPSS Technical Working Group (MHPSS TWG) has not been established, this can also guide us on how to coordinate within our sector. Therefore, it is strongly recommended that you look at the key actions under this activity to ensure that your organization is making a positive contribution to coordination.

rows.en: Explain that there is a dedicated IASC handbook on MHPSS coordination, which was also released in 2022 – it’s consistent with the checklist for MSP Activity 1.1 (Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors), but goes in to much more detail on how to coordinate.
rows.ne: MHPSS समन्वयसम्बन्धी छुट्टै IASC पुस्तिका छ र त्यो पनि 2022 मा प्रकाशित भएको हो भन्ने कुरा स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्। यो MSP गतिविधि 1.1 (क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने) को जाँचसूचीसँग सुसङ्गत छ, तर यसमा कसरी समन्वय गर्ने भन्ने विषयमा धेरै विस्तृत जानकारी छ भन्ने कुरा पनि स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Clarify that there is a separate IASC handbook on MHPSS coordination and that it too was published in 2022. Also clarify that it is consistent with the checklist for MSP activity 1.1 (Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors), but that it contains much more detailed information on how to coordinate.
rows.note: Proposed recurring term: handbook = पुस्तिका.

rows.en: The handbook provides guidance on how to best support well-coordinated and multisectoral MHPSS responses that are predictable, accountable, equitable, efficient and effective.
rows.ne: यस पुस्तिकाले सुव्यवस्थित रूपमा समन्वय गरिएको, बहु-क्षेत्रगत, पूर्वानुमान गर्न सकिने, जवाफदेही, समतामूलक, दक्ष र प्रभावकारी MHPSS प्रतिकार्यलाई सर्वोत्तम रूपमा कसरी सहयोग गर्ने भन्ने विषयमा मार्गदर्शन प्रदान गर्छ।
rows.bt: This handbook provides guidance on how best to support a well-coordinated, multisectoral, predictable, accountable, equitable, efficient and effective MHPSS response.
rows.note: Proposed recurring term: handbook = पुस्तिका.
